value.authority_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Export permission is evaluated for the selected source; namespace existence grants no read rights. [2] Namespace visibility does not grant export/read authority.
value.byte_rule: Byte-identical package export is a separate explicit distribution operation and must not be confused with semantic reserialization.
value.concrete_rule: Only concrete executable descendants dispatch export operations.
value.format_rule: Output format is serialization, not semantic ownership.
value.help_rule: Family roots may carry master help/metadata while concrete commands carry their own short/long help.
value.identity_rule: Full recursive namespace path is the command identity.
value.modality_rule: Files, images, audio, video, code and future modalities remain extensible subfamilies.
value.recursive_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] export may contain nested modality/category namespaces and concrete output commands. [2] Subfamilies may nest recursively, e.g. `export.files.json`.
value.root_rule: `export` is a command-family namespace and is not executable unless explicitly declared by a future compatible contract.
value.roundtrip_rule: A concrete exporter claiming semantic round-trip declares exactly which semantic surface it preserves.
value.selection_rule: Concrete export command selects explicit source identities/projections.
